summary: Research value is real but bounded: repeated distance judgments separate accuracy, consistency and variability, while current controls prevent overinterpretation. The explanatory return on more provider families alone is low. Prioritize diagnostic cross-task prediction, reviewed prompt/time replication and calibrated uncertainty; select families to test generality of the resulting effect. Cognitive Processing is the most practical cognitive route; Spatial Cognition & Computation has direct subject fit but a substantive AI-drafting eligibility hold. No present result measures a hidden map, human process or cultural mechanism.
